views.name: hcpcs_canonical
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  RECID AS recid,
  HCPC AS hcpc_code,
  SEQNUM AS seqnum,
  LONG_DESCRIPTION AS long_description,
  SHORT_DESCRIPTION AS short_description,
  STATUTE AS statute,
  COV AS coverage,
  OPPS AS opps,
  SAFE_CAST(NULLIF(ACT_EFF_DT, '') AS DATE) AS effective_date,
  SAFE_CAST(NULLIF(TERM_DT, '') AS DATE) AS termination_date,
  SAFE_CAST(NULLIF(ADD_DT, '') AS DATE) AS add_date,
  MCM1 AS mcm1,
  MCM2 AS mcm2,
  ACTION_CD AS action_flag
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_codes.hcpcs`
grain: recid (one row per hcpcs RECID / version record)
views.description: Normalized/cleaned HCPCS code dimension. Canonicalizes key fields, parses obvious date-like string columns to DATE where possible, and exposes versioning identifiers. Use this when joining provider facts to HCPCS metadata or when filtering by effective/termination dates. | Use for: Join HCPCS metadata to physician/supplier claims by hcpcs_code; Find HCPCS codes active during a date range (use effective_date/termination_date); Filter to HCPCS with non-null price or MCM measures

views.name: hcpcs_latest_by_code
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  recid,
  hcpc_code,
  seqnum,
  long_description,
  short_description,
  statute,
  coverage,
  opps,
  effective_date,
  termination_date,
  add_date,
  mcm1,
  mcm2,
  action_flag,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY hcpc_code ORDER BY COALESCE(effective_date, DATE '0001-01-01') DESC, recid DESC) AS version_rank
FROM hcpcs_canonical
grain: one row per hcpc_code + recid (version) with version_rank
views.description: Latest HCPCS version per HCPC code by effective_date then recid. Exposes a rank so downstream queries can select top-N versions per code. Useful for obtaining the most recent description/metadata for each HCPCS. | Use for: Select most recent HCPCS description per code (WHERE version_rank = 1); Compare older vs newer HCPCS versions; Restrict to HCPCS versions active at a date then join to claims

views.name: icd10_procedures_lookup
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pcs_code AS pcs_code,
  order_number AS order_number,
  is_header_code AS is_header_code,
  short_description AS short_description,
  long_description AS long_description
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_codes.icd10_procedures_2019`
grain: one row per ICD-10-PCS code or header (pcs_code or header rows)
views.description: Normalized ICD-10-PCS procedure code table. Preserves header flag and order_number. Use for lookups or joining procedure codes to other data. | Use for: Lookup description for a given pcs_code; Filter to non-header procedure codes for analysis; Aggregate counts of procedures by description

views.name: icd10_diagnoses_lookup
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cm_code AS cm_code,
  order_number AS order_number,
  is_header_code AS is_header_code,

grain: one row per ICD-10 diagnosis code or header
views.description: Normalized ICD-10 diagnosis code table (2019 snapshot). Preserve header rows and descriptions for joins/filters. | Use for: Map diagnosis codes to descriptions; Filter to actual codes (is_header_code = FALSE); Join diagnosis metadata to claims with diagnosis codes

views.name: icd9_diagnoses_lookup
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  DIAGNOSIS_CODE AS icd9_code,

FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_codes.icd9_diagnoses`
grain: one row per ICD-9 diagnosis code
views.description: ICD-9 diagnosis code lookup (clean projection). Useful for historical mappings or joining legacy-coded claims. | Use for: Lookup ICD-9 descriptions; Join legacy diagnosis codes to modern datasets

views.name: physicians_supplier_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  npi AS npi,
  nppes_provider_last_org_name AS provider_last_org_name,
  nppes_provider_first_name AS provider_first_name,
  nppes_provider_mi AS provider_mi,
  nppes_credentials AS credentials,
  nppes_provider_gender AS gender,
  nppes_entity_code AS entity_code,
  nppes_provider_city AS city,
  nppes_provider_state AS state,
  nppes_provider_zip AS zip,
  provider_type AS provider_type,
  place_of_service AS place_of_service,
  hcpcs_code AS hcpcs_code,
  hcpcs_description AS hcpcs_description,
  line_srvc_cnt AS line_service_count,
  bene_unique_cnt AS beneficiary_count,
  bene_day_srvc_cnt AS beneficiary_day_service_count,
  average_medicare_allowed_amt AS avg_allowed_amount,
  average_submitted_chrg_amt AS avg_submitted_charge,
  average_medicare_payment_amt AS avg_medicare_payment,
  stdev_medicare_allowed_amt AS stdev_allowed_amount,
  stdev_submitted_chrg_amt AS stdev_submitted_charge,
  stdev_medicare_payment_amt AS stdev_medicare_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.physicians_and_other_supplier_2013`
grain: one row per (npi, place_of_service, hcpcs_code) as in source
views.description: Provider-HCPCS-level aggregated measures from the physicians_and_other_supplier_2013 table. Exposes provider identifiers, location, HCPCS and common summary measures with explicit aliases. Use this as the canonical fact table for provider-HCPCS analysis. | Use for: Aggregate provider-level service counts/payments for a HCPCS; Find providers with highest average medicare payment for a code; Join with hcpcs_canonical to enrich hcpcs_description or filter by effective_date

views.name: home_health_agency_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  provider_id AS provider_id,
  agency_name AS agency_name,
  street_address AS street_address,
  city AS city,
  state AS state,
  zip_code AS zip_code,
  total_episodes_non_lupa AS total_episodes_non_lupa,
  distinct_beneficiaries_non_lupa AS distinct_beneficiaries_non_lupa,
  average_number_of_total_visits_per_episode_non_lupa AS avg_total_visits_per_episode_non_lupa,
  total_hha_charge_amount_non_lupa AS total_charge_amount_non_lupa,
  total_hha_medicare_payment_amount_non_lupa AS total_medicare_payment_non_lupa,
  average_age AS average_age,
  male_beneficiaries AS male_beneficiaries,
  female_beneficiaries AS female_beneficiaries,
  average_hcc_score AS average_hcc_score
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.home_health_agencies_2014`
grain: one row per home health agency (provider_id) for 2014
views.description: Canonical, flattened home health agency table with provider identifiers, geography and common measures for 2014. Use this as the main HHA fact table for comparisons, filtering by geography, and aggregations. | Use for: Compare HHA total payments or episodes across states or agencies; Filter agencies by volume or average visits per episode; Join agency to other provider-level datasets by provider_id or geography

views.name: inpatient_charges_provider_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  provider_id AS provider_id,
  provider_name AS provider_name,
  provider_city AS provider_city,
  provider_state AS provider_state,
  drg_definition AS drg_definition,
  total_discharges AS total_discharges,
  average_total_payments AS avg_total_payments,
  average_medicare_payments AS avg_medicare_payments,
  average_covered_charges AS avg_covered_charges
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2013`
grain: one row per provider_id + drg_definition as in source
views.description: Clean projection of inpatient_charges_2013 provider-level DRG entries. Preserves provider identifiers, DRG definition and location plus common charge/payment measures for downstream aggregation or joins. | Use for: Compare average Medicare payments for DRGs across hospitals; Identify high-charge DRGs by provider; Aggregate discharges/payments by state or DRG group
